title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices
abstract: arXiv:2609.37988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). translated_title: KV-Kaizen：学习上下文自适应的缓存压缩选择
translated_abstract: 随着使用大语言模型（LLM）处理的文本上下文长度不断增长，KV缓存的大小可能会超出为原始模型权重所分配的内存。这会对LLM的吞吐量产生负面影响，因为解码过程受内存限制，且解码成本会随缓存大小增长。近期的工作通过丢弃最不相关的token来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，丢弃操作引入了一种矛盾：一次性的丢弃决定可能在后续被证明是有害的。因此，我们转而研究能够在不丢弃token的情况下实现缓存压缩的替代选择。我们通过学习一个选择器来实现这一目标，该选择器能够基于上下文生成逐层的缓存配置，以满足整体的压缩预算。该选择器沿三个维度进行操作：跨层共享同一个缓存（深度）、以更少的比特数进行缓存（精度）、或截断低秩的潜在缓存表示（秩）。我们将所得方法称为KV-Kaizen，取意于其由许多微小的逐层选择……
tldr: KV-Kaizen提出了一种上下文自适应的KV缓存压缩方法，通过学习一个选择器在不丢弃token的前提下，沿深度（跨层共享缓存）、精度（降低缓存比特数）和秩（截断低秩潜在表示）三个维度为每一层做出缓存配置选择，以满足整体压缩预算并提升LLM解码吞吐量。
en_tdlr: KV-Kaizen learns a context-adaptive selector that compresses KV caches without token eviction by making per-layer choices along three axes—depth (cross-layer cache sharing), precision (fewer cache bits), and rank (truncating low-rank latent representations)—to meet an overall compression budget and improve LLM decoding throughput.
